description: Hyperbliss Technologies makes open source software that puts you in control: Hypercolor for RGB lighting, Sibyl for agent memory, and unifly for UniFi networks.

front.bio: An independent software company in Seattle, founded by Stefanie Jane. Open source at the core.
front.tagline: {hyperbliss} makes software that puts you in control of your own technology: one lighting engine for your PC, your smart lights, and your whole room, memory for your coding agents, and terminal tools worth living in.
